note: Engineered-structure study (rra.1602) votes decrease vs reference streams; groin-vs-other-structure and structure-type contrasts given null (no presence/absence sign). Boulder clusters (f03-013) vote increase. Woody debris edges concern small mammals, not invertebrates.

Functional traits read as organism-level height/height increment and per-plant shoot mass; plot-level root mass (e3, e19), germination, cover and richness excluded. Wood chip incorporation is not surface mulch; e45 sentence does not support the mulch-site SLA claim. Slash cover treated as surface cover.

Tree cover taken as tree dominance; block-cut surfaces had more trees, post-vacuum sites less tree cover. Mounding, restoration and plant-community (non-tree) composition edges excluded. Candidates look thin for tree species composition.
e8 and e9 contradict each other for the same 1994 Tableland plots; study votes 0 by plurality. Cover soil, germination mat, density and cover edges excluded.
Richness edges (e29, e31, e32) treated as number of species, not diversity/evenness; moss layer transfer treated as diaspore transfer, not planting.

Planting-condition contrasts (site, substrate, seedling size, species, position, fertilization) excluded as not planting vs no planting. e40 subject years conflict with its sentence (other planting years lacked growth); kept as -1, making that study internally mixed. Few edges compare planted vs unplanted.
Acid/S deposition and metal edges concern lake or station water chemistry, not soil; soil edges involve amendments (sewage sludge, pyrogenic carbon, N fertilisation), not pollutants.
Woody debris survival edges concern small mammals; residual-tree edge (e25) is seedling stocking/density, not survival.
